body.p: The three main general purpose clock crossing dielets are XTAL, CROCLK and BCLK. XTAL, CROCLK and BCLK are generated at SOC-South and send to SOC-North. BCLK has extra option whereby it can be generated by SOC-North BCLKPLL and send to all other dielets. Compute die has extra bclk option to generate the bclk using local BCLKPLL in Compute die. CROCLK is sent back from dielets back to soc-north for PM Sideband forwarded clock communication purpose. XTAL, CROCLK and BCLK that sent to all dielets (Compute, GFX, Base) are expected to have clkreq/ack handshaking to Soc-North (not shown in diagram above).
